headline: Earnings surge on record inflows and AI-fueled deployment
summary_short: Blackstone reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of $1.54 (basic and diluted), up 85.5% q/q and 57.1% y/y, as revenue reached $5.044 billion (+39.4% q/q, +35.9% y/y) on record quarterly inflows of $68.3 billion and cross-strategy appreciation.
summary_long: Revenue rose to $5.044 billion (+39.4% q/q, +35.9% y/y) as Performance Allocations and Fee Related Earnings grew on $68.3 billion of quarterly inflows and cross-strategy appreciation, which lifted Net Accrued Performance Revenues to $7.5 billion. EPS reached $1.54 (+85.5% q/q, +57.1% y/y); net income growth (+89.2% q/q) outpaced the 22.9% rise in total expenses, expanding margins. CEO Schwarzman credited the quarter to leaning into the AI investment megatrend. Total AUM grew 11% y/y to $1.346 trillion. Cash was $2.507 billion against $13.319 billion of long-term debt; equity rose to $9.015 billion. Blackstone declared a $1.29/share dividend; the release included no forward guidance.

drivers.explanation: CEO Schwarzman attributed the quarter's growth to "leaning into the artificial intelligence megatrend," saying it drove standout investment performance and record capital inflows across strategies.

Appreciation across strategies led to higher Net Accrued Performance Revenues quarter-over-quarter, and Performance Allocations and Fee Related Earnings both grew on $68.3 billion of quarterly inflows, per the release.
Margin expansion is largely arithmetic: revenue grew 35.9% y/y while total expenses (compensation, G&A, interest, fund expenses) rose only 22.9% y/y per the release's GAAP income statement.
